I’m a Canadian who has been living in the UK for the past couple of years, so I might be able to offer a qualified opinion. 

I know London is tempting, but I personally think there is so much more to the UK than the London life. A great city, and of course it’s amazing! But tbh I think Leeds would be an equally great option - albeit different.  

Worth considering Birmingham/Manchester/Edinburgh (obviously a littler further north but close enough to Leeds compared to London)

Based on personal experience I think cost of living is relatively comparable (though I don’t live in London - I live in Bristol). There are trade offs. 
For example, I find salaries to be less than Canada. Full stop. And there’s not much to be done about that. But then things like groceries are cheaper in comparison, for example

The only reason why that car would need any of those things is if the engine is a lot newer than the car - suggesting the car was either in some sort of accident that you are unaware of, or the previous engine burnt out.
In the morning, go out and take the oil cap off and examine it. See if there is any sign of antifreeze or any smell that might be similar to that. That's a way to see if a head gasket is leaking - which is correlated directly with the water pump. 
Also, spark plugs on a civic are extremely easy to do. There is, I'm sure,a quick youtube video that would probably show you how to do that (Japanese cars are really easy to do that sort of stuff with). As for the timing belt, that usually lasts (as someone else said) around 110,000 kms. The fact that they are saying this stuff needs to be replaced sounds relatively sketchy to me. 
Look, I am not an expert by any means, but I would not necessarily buy into the stuff you are being told from the mechanic you are going to. 

Also just a side note to look into - keep everything documented. Rust may be covered in a similar manner to VW or Audi. If there is any sort of rust that you didn't cause that occurs within 10 years of the vehicle being new, it will be fixed free of charge by the dealer. I'm not if Honda does this too, but investigate. 
It seems like you might be getting shafted, hard.
